## Walkthrough Updated module `cluster-api/providers/ibmcloud/go.mod`: bumped Go version to 1.25.8, removed the explicit `toolchain` directive, upgraded `sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-ibmcloud` to v0.12.2, and regenerated the require block with many transitive dependency version changes and added indirect deps. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Go module file**
`cluster-api/providers/ibmcloud/go.mod`|Changed `go` directive from `1.23.2` → `1.25.8`; removed `toolchain` (`go1.23.7`). Upgraded `sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-ibmcloud` from `v0.11.0-alpha...` → `v0.12.2`. Regenerated `require (...)` list: added several new indirect dependencies (e.g., `cel.dev/expr`, `github.com/google/btree`, `go.opentelemetry.io/auto/sdk`, `gopkg.in/evanphx/json-patch.v4`), removed others, and bumped many versions across IBM SDKs, AWS SDK, OpenAPI/go-openapi, gRPC gateway, OpenTelemetry, `golang.org/x/*`, `k8s.io/*`, and `sigs.k8s.io/*`. (+82/-82 lines)| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 10

Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | PR only modifies go.mod dependency configuration with no test file changes. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | PR only modifies Go module dependency configuration file, containing no Ginkgo test files. Custom check for test code quality is not applicable. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR only updates go.mod dependencies and the Go version; no new Ginkgo e2e tests are added. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR only updates Go module dependencies and versions with no new Ginkgo e2e tests added, so SNO test compatibility requirements do not apply. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR only modifies go.mod dependencies without introducing scheduling constraints or HA topology assumptions in deployment manifests or controller code. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR updates only go.mod and go.sum files with no changes to source code that could violate OTE Binary Stdout Contract; logging already properly configured. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR only modifies cluster-api/providers/ibmcloud/go.mod with dependency and Go version updates. No new Ginkgo e2e test files or test code are being added. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The PR title accurately describes the main change: updating Cluster API (CAPI) to v0.12.2, which is the primary objective evident in the go.mod changes. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. |
